svg.title: IGBT
svg.desc: IGBT, IEEE 315-1975 §8.2.8 insulated gate and §8.2.4 emitter primitives; IGBT composite is post-1975 industry practice (not a dedicated IEEE 315-1975 symbol). Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: c (88,8), g (8,40), e (88,72).
